root_cause: The Frisse Blik landing page describes a service with a fixed price and offset on later implementation, but its open-graph description and JSON-LD WebApplication offers describe a free scan/price 0. This contradicts public page intent and may create misleading search/share expectations for LinkedIn visitors.

observed_evidence.site_body: Frisse Blik Scan is offset if implementation follows; the separate Zelfscan is explicitly free.

fix: Remove the unsupported offer €0 from the service JSON-LD and distinguish paid/price-agreed Frisse Blik Scan from free self-scan in meta/OG descriptions. Do not invent any numeric price, lead, uplift or customer case.
prevention_rule: Schema.org price/offers and search/social meta claims must reflect the actual product, not a neighboring free lead magnet. Never imply a causal conversion lift without attributed lead/order evidence. Do not create another scheduler.
terminal_rule: Exact PR Required and CodeQL, protected merge, Netlify production deploy and independent view-source/meta parity. Conversion lift remains an unproven future measurement obligation.
